digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport layer retry/error handling
propositions: Jira Data Center rate-limit 429 responses are not honoured; the transport fails immediately without checking Retry-After headers or applying backoff.
A 429 response cannot be retried through _with_connection_retry at the mutation layer because it may arrive after the server begins writing, risking duplicate creates/updates.
The transport module is locked at 800 lines with only 11 lines of headroom, forcing the retry/error cluster to extract to a separate module before 429 policy can be implemented.
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in defaulting to OFF; mutations must fail-fast to avoid reintroducing the duplicate-issue defect.
Retry-After must be parsed with jitter (up to 20% random) applied before clamping to MAX_BACKOFF_S (60 seconds), and cap-exhausted retries must raise BackendHTTPError(code=429) not raw JIRAError.
